description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Scott
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Sunscorch (0~2), removed after using Sunscorch two times

description.name: Sunscorch Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Sunscorch level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Scott]

description.name: Sunscorch Level
description.text: Keeps track of Sunscorch level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Scott]
